last_run_summary.critical_timing_alert: PNOC022 Cohort 6 window (4-14 weeks post-RT) closes approximately November 1, 2026 — approximately 10 days from this run. IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED.

last_run_summary.notes: Extended multilingual research completed October 21, 2026 via parallel agents (English/Hebrew/EU agent + Japanese/Asian/WHO ICTRP agent). BIOMEDE 2.0 confirmed NOT eligible post-RT. Critical new finding: EGFR exon 20 insertion may reduce ONC201 efficacy — molecular tumor board consultation essential before ACTION/PNOC022 enrollment. BLU5082 is the most promising EGFR-specific option but preclinical only. ACT001 (Canada/Australia/Europe) is a new option not previously analyzed.
